inputs.checklistItemText: Plans not submitted or referenced for AULCC when excavations exceed 25 LF in DAPCZ or 300 LF outside DAPCZ (ROW-02)
inputs.question: On this water and wastewater plan, identify where the property line intersects the utility lines. How much of the proposed water and wastewater piping (WT-01, WT-02, WW-01) is located within the public right-of-way (outside the property line) versus on private property?
inputs.regionHint: Look for where the property line (solid line) crosses the utility alignment drawings in the plan views

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for a quantitative determination of how much piping length falls within vs. outside the property line (ROW boundary), which requires plan-view distance/length measurement between the property line and utility features to establish excavation footage in the DAPCZ or outside it—the core compliance trigger for the AULCC requirement.
